metadata.label: CapEx growth and subsequent sector performance
metadata.methodology: Fiscal-year nominal CapEx growth is paired with subsequent market returns at 0, 6 and 12 months; preceding market returns ending 3, 6 and 12 months before CapEx; and private corporate GFCF/GDP at 0, 1 and 2 fiscal years.

nominal_capex_growth.label: Actual nominal CapEx growth
nominal_capex_growth.methodology: Year-on-year change in actual central-government capital expenditure.
nominal_capex_growth.source_note: Nominal growth includes inflation and does not measure project quality.

capital_goods_lag_0m.label: Nifty Capital Goods: subsequent 12-month excess return (0-month lag)
capital_goods_lag_0m.methodology: Compound monthly sector-minus-benchmark returns over the subsequent 12 months.
capital_goods_lag_0m.source_note: Small annual samples are descriptive and do not establish causality.

private_gfcf_lag_0y.label: Private corporate GFCF/GDP (0-year lag)
private_gfcf_lag_0y.methodology: Private corporate GFCF/GDP aligned to the CapEx fiscal year at a fixed annual lag.
private_gfcf_lag_0y.source_note: The consistent national-accounts history is too short for a reliable correlation estimate.
